text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While looking for Meisho Doto, who hadn't 
shown up even though it was time for 
training—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-P-Positivity from cosmic energy...? And 
the effects last forever?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-To think such an amazing product 
existed...! I'll buy it! Give me one, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, purchasing the Space Wristband, are 
we? Well then, as for the price...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fueh, Trainer-san!? Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oho, ohohoho~! I just remembered I have 
something to do, so excuse me~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
choice_data_list: More importantly, it's time for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I warned Meisho Doto to be more mindful of 
training time...
